questions.text: Look at Lina’s picture card. Which report matches the marked food?
questions.discussion: Kartu menampilkan es krim dengan tanda silang yang bermakna No.

questions.text: Look at Oki’s card. What two things does it tell us?
options: Oki likes milk but doesn’t like tea.
Oki likes tea but doesn’t like milk.
questions.answer: Oki likes tea but doesn’t like milk.
questions.discussion: Gelas teh diberi centang dan karton susu diberi silang. Legenda menjelaskan kedua tanda.

questions.text: Use the survey card. Who likes bread and milk?
questions.discussion: Pada baris Dara, kedua kolom bertanda centang. Rino menyukai susu, tetapi tidak menyukai roti.

questions.text: Which food is missing a survey answer on Dini’s card?
questions.discussion: Kolom pizza berisi tanda tanya yang berarti belum dijawab. Roti dan nasi sudah ditandai, sedangkan mi tidak tercantum.

questions.text: Read the two illustrated cards. What can we say about both children?
options: They like the same two foods.
questions.discussion: Pisang diberi tanda silang pada kedua kartu. Tanda pada roti dan mi berbeda.

questions.text: Look at the speech bubble. Which sentence retells Yuni’s answer?
questions.discussion: Balon ucapan Yuni menolak kopi. Laporan tentang Yuni menggunakan bentuk doesn’t like.

questions.text: The arrow points to a snack. Does Bima like it?
options: The card marks both Yes and No.
The card leaves the snack unmarked.
questions.discussion: Panah menunjuk roti yang diberi tanda centang. Tanda silang pada kartu berlaku untuk es krim.

questions.text: Match the card number to the sentence “Sita likes noodles.”
questions.discussion: Kartu 2 memuat nama Sita, gambar mi, dan centang. Kartu lain berbeda pada nama, gambar, atau tanda.

questions.text: Compare the two surveys. Which drink gets a Yes from only one child?
questions.discussion: Teh mendapat satu centang. Susu dicentang keduanya, kopi disilang keduanya, dan air tidak ditampilkan.

questions.text: Use the illustrated card. Which question would get “No, I don’t” from Rani?
options: Do you like bread and milk?
questions.discussion: Rani menandai pizza dengan silang. Roti dan susu masing-masing dicentang.
